stories.title: Asian Games Day 6 — China, Chinese Taipei Win; Medal Round Set for Saturday

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: The Asian Games softball medal round is set. Japan and China close the prelim round undefeated — both play Saturday at Anjo Sports Park in the gold medal game, a direct LA28 Olympic qualifier. #Softball

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Day 6 in Anjo: China beat Korea 8-4 (three home runs), Chinese Taipei run-ruled the Philippines 10-1, and Hong Kong edged Singapore 5-2 in a rain-shortened game. Gold medal Saturday. #Softball #AsianGames

stories.title: Jaysoni Beachum Leaves FSU — No. 1 Transfer Portal Target Visits Florida

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text: Florida State's Jaysoni Beachum is in the transfer portal. The 2026 All-American hit .406 with 10 HR and 69 RBIs — ranked No. 1 corner infielder in the portal by Softball America. #Softball

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text: Where is Jaysoni Beachum headed? The top FSU transfer visited Florida this week, posting a photo in a Gators uniform. No commitment yet — but the recruitment race is on. #Softball #Gators
